title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_power_of_when_by_michael_breus_pj2mk (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_power_of_when_by_michael_breus_pj2mk' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
